files.observation: DTI model derives available=max(0,income*targetDti/100-debt), then loan-analysis inverse, adds downPayment; money/DTI2dp. Does not subtract supplied transport running costs without an explicit adapter/mapping.

paymentForLoan and maxPrincipalForPayment use nominal annualPercent/100/12; zero-rate branches; schedules stop at balance<=0.005, round each row to2dp then sum rounded payments/interest. Does not select debt-consolidation, rental or transport-budget contract.

roundTo uses binary Number, default half-away-from-zero with scaled Number.EPSILON tie tolerance; integer short circuit; digits0..12. Observed implementation default is not an approved product rounding policy.
